metric_expectations.source_text: Out-of-sample Sharpe ≥ 1.0 net of modeled costs.
DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count.
Max drawdown ≤ 20% in any walk-forward fold.
Parameter sensitivity: ±25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline.
No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL.
metric_expectations.notes: Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because OL-0013.metrics does not include a 90-day contribution metric.
Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because OL-0013.metrics does not include free_parameter_count.

realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-10w uses the next-most-recent contiguous equivalent-length evaluation window before REP-0012 / OL-0012: 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. No separate IS metric convention is introduced; in_sample.sharpe records the same actual window Sharpe for schema continuity.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0013 records sharpe at or above that threshold.
D2-006 requires DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count; OL-0013 records dsr equal to 1.0, which does not satisfy the strict greater-than threshold.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0013 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires parameter sensitivity to keep Sharpe within 70% of baseline under +/-25% parameter shifts; OL-0013 records sensitivity_min_ratio at or above that threshold.
D2-006 requires cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL; OL-0013 records positive gross_pnl and cost_drag_fraction above that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0013 records walk_forward_efficiency above that threshold.

interpretation: WP-10y is a Stage 2 Path A D2-only REC append. REC-0024 derives from OL-0013 and reconciles against D2-006 only using committed D2-006 source text and copied OL metrics. It compares cost_drag_fraction because OL-0013.metrics.gross_pnl > 0, and OL-0013.metrics.cost_drag_fraction does not meet the D2-006 <= 0.5 threshold. The selected exact segment H-004 / research_oos / post_wp_5b / d2_006_gates moves from 2 to 3 REC observations and crosses REC-5 for that exact segment only. This creates no policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper-live, runtime, lifecycle, promotion, demotion, Path B, cohort, or protected-path authority, and WP-10v PC-3 still requires a separate post-floor-crossing direction decision before further Stage 2 work.
